name: Hana'zua
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Hana'zua lies wounded after meeting Sarkoth on the canyon ridges. The Darkspear scout waits for help from young Horde initiates.

sections.title: A Scout Fallen to Venom
sections.body: Hana'zua lies wounded on the ridges above the Valley of Trials. The Darkspear scout met Sarkoth, a vicious scorpid that stalks the cliffs, and its venomous sting nearly killed him. Unable to move or make his way back to camp, he waits in the dust for passing recruits. He needs them to kill Sarkoth and carry word of his plight to the Den.

faq.answer: Hana'zua is a wounded Darkspear troll scout in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Beasts on the ridges ambushed and poisoned him.
Sarkoth, a large scorpid lurking on the crags above the training grounds, struck Hana'zua down. Its venom left him unable to move or return to safety.

faq.q: What does he ask travelers to do?
faq.answer: Hana'zua asks travelers to kill Sarkoth, bring back the beast's claw as proof, and carry word of his condition to the instructors at the Den.

angles.text: As a Darkspear initiate beginning your journey in Durotar, you may find a wounded kinsman among the local wildlife's dangers. Protecting your new allies matters.
For the Horde, helping Hana'zua survive and avenge his wound is an early test of your loyalty and readiness to fight.
